name: Did this help?
description: Displays a block with a "Did this help?" (Yes/No) question, collects reasons and a free-text message for "No", and reports the answers via a Views page.
project_description: Displays a block with a "Did this help?" (is useful) question and Yes/No options. Choosing "No" reveals a configurable list of ready-made answers plus an "Other" option and a short free-text message field. Every response is stored with the page URL, page title, the answering user, and the visitor IP, and results are reported on a Views page at /admin/reports/did-this-help. The question text and the list of "No" answers are configurable at /admin/config/did_this_help/settings. Ships Views integration (custom table, fields, filters, and a Yes/No filter plugin).
